text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the Kikuka Sho—Narita Taishin skips 
school and training to spend her days in 
lethargy, until a certain basketball game 
catches her by surprise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one shining on TV was the small, 
red-haired girl who had hurled harsh words 
at Narita Taishin before the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"A girl who received the 'courage to never 
give up' from someone who, though twisted, 
was stronger than anyone and never threw 
in the towel."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket shares that Narita 
Taishin's unyielding strength in the face 
of adversity has always encouraged her and 
fired her up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And receiving sincere encouragement from 
her Trainer, who believed in Narita 
Taishin and waited every day for her 
return—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having reclaimed her resolve to never give 
up, Narita Taishin resolved to get her 
revenge in the Nikkei Sho.
